client_id.title: Client ID
client_id.description: Client ID of the Jortt OAuth application, registered under Settings > API in your Jortt administration.

client_secret.title: Client Secret
client_secret.description: Client secret of the Jortt OAuth application.

organization_id.title: Organization ID
organization_id.description: Administration to read. Required when the credentials may act on more than one administration; list them with GET /v3/organizations.

start_date.title: Start date
start_date.description: Expenses with a VAT date before this date are not synced on the first incremental run.

scopes.title: Scopes
scopes.description: OAuth scopes to request. Leave empty to use the read-only scopes the source needs.
scopes.default: customers:read invoices:read estimates:read expenses:read organizations:read reconciling:read
